Only the new test file was added; the pre-existing deletions are untouched, as required.

## Summary

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 5 test class (matching the project's existing `junit-jupiter` style with static `Assertions` imports) covering `CSVFormat`'s public API:

- All predefined format constants (`DEFAULT`, `EXCEL`, `MYSQL`, `ORACLE`, `RFC4180`, `TDF`, MongoDB/PostgreSQL/Informix variants) and the `Predefined` enum/`valueOf`
- `Builder` construction (`create()`, `create(CSVFormat)`, `get()`/`build()`), fluent chaining, and every setter's validation rules (line-break rejection, empty delimiter, null `DuplicateHeaderMode`)
- Header handling: `String[]`, `Enum` class, mocked `ResultSet`/`ResultSetMetaData` (via Mockito), defensive copying, and duplicate-header modes
- `validate()` invariants (quote/escape/comment clashing with delimiter or each other, `QuoteMode.NONE` requiring an escape char)
- All getters, `equals`/`hashCode`, `toString`
- `format(...)`, `parse(Reader)`, `print`/`println`/`printRecord` to `Appendable`, `File`, `Path`, and `System.out`
- Edge cases around `print(Object, Appendable, boolean)`: trimming, quote modes, `Reader`/`InputStream` values, multi-char delimiters, and the null-value-starting-a-record quoting behavior from the most recent commit
- Deprecated `withXxx(...)` methods, verified against their `Builder` equivalents

Ran `mvn test -Dtest=CSVFormatAgentTest`: **133 tests, all passing**. No other files were modified.
